ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.45:0.55 ratio of high-intensity (white) background to low-intensity (black) pigmentation clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centrally concentrated contiguous black pigmentation around the median notch; high-frequency discrete black mottling and blobs distributed across the lateral white fields of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a central angle of approximately 105 degrees and significant vertical depth into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuously serrated boundary along the trailing edge with pixel-amplitude variations (peaks and valleys) ranging from 5 to 20 pixels in depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep originating from the median notch transitioning into a convex curve toward the distal lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density distribution of circular, high-contrast rings (white perimeter on black or black on white) clustered in the medial and lower regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Sparse, faint unaligned linear pixel disruptions visible against the high-intensity white background on the lower left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, high-relief calcified clusters of acorn barnacles localized on the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique and pervasive distribution of circular 'rosette' scarring patterns across the majority of the pigmented transition zones.
